concerns.text: FR‑001 (download raw compositional and property data from Materials Project **and** NIST) is not covered – tasks T009a (download Materials Project data) and T009c (merge sources) are missing; only T009b (optional NIST fallback) is present.
FR‑002 (filter to monolithic aluminum alloys with required fields) lacks a dedicated task (e.g., T011) that implements the monolithic‑alloy filter; no task explicitly performs this filter.

FR‑003 (unit normalisation of elastic constants and composition‑sum checks, exclusion of entries with major‑element sum < 0.95) is not represented – tasks T012 (unit normalisation) and T013 (major‑element sum exclusion) are absent.
FR‑009 (verification that Poisson’s ratio values are independent measurements) has no corresponding task; a task that inspects `poisson_source` and excludes non‑independent records is missing.
FR‑010 (stoichiometric formula parsing and conversion to atomic fractions) is not covered by any task; a task that implements the chemparse‑based conversion and adds the Al balance is missing.
SC‑001 (measure dataset completeness against both Materials Project and NIST) is not linked to any task; no task records or reports the completeness metrics.
SC‑006 (measure data independence of Poisson’s ratio) is unaddressed; there is no task that quantifies the count of excluded non‑independent entries or logs this as a success‑criterion.
